name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road in a day
description_md:
Grossglockner High Alpine Road in a day is a waymarked hiking route in Austria. The distance of the route is 14.1 km.

Walkers can expect a walking time of about 7.0 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
